# Android app 1.3.1: tablet display size and charge-limit dialog fixed
### Fixed
- **Android app 1.3.1: text and icons were too small on tablets.** The app showed the page in "overview mode", which shrank it on a tablet. Overview mode now applies to TVs only; on a tablet the display is as it was with Fully.
- **Android app 1.3.1: the "Charge limit" dialog showed only text and "Close".** Android hides the choices when a dialog also has a message. Text and choices are now in one list.
- **The app file attached to the release is now really the new one.** It was the old 1.0.0 from Oct 10 (the CI only carries over the previous release's APK, it does not build one), so the tablet player, the Fully bridge and the charge limit of 1.2 and 1.3 were missing from the download.

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
